# Diffusion Point Transformer

- Source: https://github.com/matteo-bastico/DiffusionPointTransformer
- Commit: `cff9fe070ddd073ca5dc4dbdd0ebf2ccb25b7225`
- License: MIT
- Copied: 2026-08-02

The DiPT model and its required Pointcept utilities are vendored here. Imports
and registry decorators were adapted so the files work as a self-contained
package. Project-specific Flow Matching integration lives in
`src/models/dipt_backbone.py`.
